alex: Heads-up — hotfix PR #1209 needs 2x LGTM before 11:00 PT cutoff. Tiny rollback for model-serving flag flip. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1209

maria: On it, will run a quick smoke locally and check the canary notes.

jordan: I can jump on this in ~20m. Anything tricky or just the flag guard?

alex: Pretty mechanical — one-line revert + a guard. Diff is small: `git show origin/pr/1209`. Smoke command: `make smoke-test` (runs basic request/health).

sam: CI had a flaky integration test last run, can someone re-run? @ci-bot ping.

ci-bot: CI: rebuild queued for PR #1209 (triggered by sam). Unit tests: ✅  Integration: flaky-fail on test_serving_latency (rerun recommended).

lee: If that integration is flaky we should avoid bouncing more infra. Could we pin the seed or add `--retry 3` to the job? Also please add the rollback steps in the PR description.

maria: Local smoke passed: `/health` OK, sample generation ok (no obvious regressions). Captured logs and linked to the PR.

jordan: Quick code read: minor null-check nit, leaving a single inline suggestion. Otherwise LGTM from me.

sam: Read through — LGTM. Approved on Github.

alex: Thanks — that's 2x LGTM. Merge plan: I'll merge when CI finishes and then kick a canary deploy. Cutoff = 11:00 PT. Rollback plan (first 30m): revert to tag `v1.42.3` and run `./scripts/deploy rollback --tag v1.42.3`. Will also alert oncall.

alex: Merging now. :rocket:

ci-bot: Deploy: canary started in us-west1 for release candidate pr-1209. Canary smoke checks: passed.

lee: Watching dashboards, no error spike so far.

maria: All good from my side — no anomalies observed. :thumbsup:

alex: Closing thread — will post if any rollback needed. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround!
